title: V3 stage-oriented refactor CP06a — protected change obligations, Git object verification and path operation authorizations
goal: Implement Plan 06 P4.1 and P4.2 with D22 and D23: a full authorization schema, a base protected change verifier that covers every protection obligation of a committed head with exactly one deleted base authorization, delete, move and case-rename authorizations, revocation-only pull requests, and a report bound to base, merge base, head and the protection configuration that the generic Diff stage requires before exempting deletions.
acceptanceCriteria: The authorization schema covers move, delete, case-rename, weaken-policy and change-trusted-base, and existing change-trusted-base records stay valid; consuming weaken-policy fails closed.

The trusted Diff derives protected removal and trusted component obligations from the raw diff without rename detection, requires exactly-once coverage by deleted base records, rejects gitlinks in the protected scope, .gitattributes changes, changed records and invalid added records, and accepts revocation-only pull requests.
The V3 and V3_ifx Diff templates are byte-identical and exempt only the deletions of a passing report bound to the verified base, merge base, head and protection configuration hash.

Test-V3.ps1 and Test-IFXTrustedBase.ps1 -DiffConsumptionOnly cover the positive and negative controls, the previous base-owned Test-V3.ps1 still passes against the candidate, and the pull request consumes the CP06a-auth authorization with all 13 required checks passing.
